smell: `apiHost: normalizeBaseUrl(input.apiHost ?? "https://api.sanity.io")` combines a body default and trailing-slash normalization for a field already modeled in `SanityConfigInput`.
proposedTarget: Move both behaviors onto `SanityConfigInput.apiHost`: `S.String.pipe(S.decodeTo(S.String, SchemaTransformation.transform({ decode: normalizeBaseUrl, encode: identity })), SchemaUtils.withKeyDefaults("https://api.sanity.io"))`; local exemplars: `packages/foundation/modeling/schema/src/CommonTextSchemas.ts:36` for `S.decodeTo` normalization and `packages/drivers/uspto/src/Uspto.config.ts:47` for config defaults.

smell: `headers: input.headers ?? {}` defaults an optional record in the resolver body.
proposedTarget: Change `SanityConfigInput.headers` to `S.Record(S.String, S.String).pipe(SchemaUtils.withKeyDefaults(R.empty()))` or an equivalent empty record default; driver exemplars include `packages/drivers/xai/src/XAi.config.ts:86` and `packages/drivers/phoenix/src/Phoenix.config.ts:53`.

smell: `params` is `S.optionalKey(S.Record(...))`, then request encoding falls back with `decoded.params ?? {}` at line 248.
proposedTarget: Give `params` an empty-record schema default, e.g. `S.Record(S.String, SanityQueryParamValue).pipe(SchemaUtils.withKeyDefaults(R.empty()))`; this mirrors `packages/drivers/xai/src/XAi.config.ts:86` for defaulted records.

smell: The decoded response model uses `ms: S.optionalKey(S.Finite)`, exposing absence as `undefined` on the domain response.
proposedTarget: Use `ms: S.OptionFromOptionalKey(S.Finite).pipe(SchemaUtils.withNoneDefault)` so decoded responses are Option-shaped while encoded Sanity responses may still omit `ms`; see `packages/drivers/pglite/src/Pglite.errors.ts:43`.

proposedTarget: Model error context with `S.OptionFromOptionalKey(...).pipe(SchemaUtils.withNoneDefault)` on both `SanityError` and `SanityErrorOptions`; local driver exemplar: `packages/drivers/pglite/src/Pglite.errors.ts:43`.
